case: Criminal complaint over a call to murder Stocker posted on an FPÖ Facebook page (2026)
type: criminal complaint against unknown persons (Stocker as the target of the alleged threat)
description: Under a post by FPÖ leader Herbert Kickl on a party Facebook account about a statement by Stocker on a 100 km/h speed limit on motorways, a user posted a call to murder the Chancellor together with the image of a firearm, which according to SOS Mitmensch was still online five days later. The human-rights organisation SOS Mitmensch filed a criminal complaint and said the party, as page operator, might be complicit by not deleting it. The Vienna public prosecutor's office confirmed to MeinBezirk that it had received the complaint and was examining it (13 April 2026).
outcome: As of the last report found (13 April 2026), the Vienna public prosecutor's office was examining the complaint; no later decision was found as of October 2026.
presumption_note: Stocker is the target of the alleged threat, not a suspect. The author of the post and anyone else concerned are presumed innocent; no charge or conviction has been reported.
key_facts: Post under a Facebook entry by Herbert Kickl on Stocker's remarks about a 100 km/h limit
Criminal complaint filed by SOS Mitmensch
Vienna public prosecutor's office confirmed receipt and examination (MeinBezirk, 13 April 2026)

case: Complaint over the billing of Wiener Neustadt council flats (from 2015)
type: criminal complaint filed by Stocker and Michael Schnedlitz (Stocker as complainant)
description: According to profil, a few months after the ÖVP and FPÖ took over the Wiener Neustadt city government in 2015, vice-mayor Stocker (ÖVP) and FPÖ city politician Michael Schnedlitz reported irregularities in the billing of municipal flats dating from the period of SPÖ rule. They filed a criminal complaint; the public prosecutor investigated and brought charges.
outcome: According to profil (January 2025), the case ended with a diversion, a settlement without a finding of guilt. The names of the accused and the court were not given in the report consulted.
court: Public prosecutor's office and criminal court competent for Wiener Neustadt (not named in the report consulted)
presumption_note: Stocker was a complainant, not an accused. A diversion is not a conviction: the persons concerned are not considered guilty and remain presumed innocent.
key_facts: Complaint filed jointly by Stocker and Schnedlitz after the 2015 change of city government (profil)
Charges were brought; the case ended with a diversion (profil)
